svg.text: Code is promoted to MAIN, not the artifact · main rebuilds its own artifact that moves through qa → stage → prod
MAIN · TRUNK (CI on merge → CD to qa, stage, prod)
merge code after QA functional passes ▲ main CI rebuilds the artifact
FEATURE BRANCH (CI on every push → CD to dev)
Only code is promoted to main. Each branch builds its own artifact: the feature build goes to dev, and the main build goes to qa, stage and prod.
Production never deploys automatically: Argo CD auto-sync is OFF for prod; a human approves the sync.
